text: Context section x4imgq6m of plugins/modules/c4s-plugin-layered-vertical-slices.md ('Wymagania wobec zawartości pakietu') at 2.1.15 still assigns content obligations to `workflows/daily.md` (protocol-of-reading referral, review-report shape closed set with empty reply = exhausted budget, cross-module-relation translation step, drift-check Dom 1–Dom 6 / L\d+ / dependent tag, full copy of the Domain rules block), while the changed section n0fj7m42 of M15 removes daily.md in favour of workflows/read.md, plan.md and apply.md. Assumption: the implementation carries those obligations into the successor workflows instead of dropping them.
